<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 151.28, 134.64, 132.51, 124.01, 123.09, and 122.26 ppm. These correspond to six distinct aromatic carbon signals, indicating six aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
